The LED screen content is clearly identifiable as a looping video of pedestrians crossing; no real pedestrians appear in the road. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

Recognizing the screen as media, the ego vehicle maintains its normal cruising speed and lane, continuing to follow the truck without slowing or stopping. temporal_caption: At 0:00 the ego camera moves forward along a dark multi-lane city avenue, headlights and neon reflecting off the asphalt, with an advertising box truck directly ahead. By 0:01 the truck's large rear LED screen is clearly visible, playing a bright looping video of pedestrians walking across a street. From 0:02 to 0:03 the moving figures are unmistakably on the screen and no real pedestrians occupy the road. From 0:03 onward the ego vehicle, recognizing the content as media, holds its lane and cruising speed, smoothly following the truck without slowing or stopping through 0:05.
